card.name: Linking words before exposure or testing terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, for, in, no, not) or part of a term, right after verbs like exposed, tested, stored or measuring in storage and screening instructions. The next words are usually a temperature, time limit or infection test.

modes.label: Exposure and storage limits
modes.description: The word 'to', 'no' or 'not' after exposure or storage wording, just before a temperature or time limit.

modes.label: Screening for infection
modes.description: The word 'for' or part of a hepatitis B or HBV term in instructions to test patients before treatment.
modes.example: Patients should be tested<< for>> latent tuberculosis before RENFLEXIS
